method: Temporary memory-only Game instances; no source edits, no persistent save edits. Probes supplement source inspection and do not claim normal-play progression or broad performance guarantees.

same_tick_replay.description: Same seed / same public command sequence / same 0.1 s tick sequence

caller_partitioning.description: Same nominal total time, different caller partitions (200×.06 s versus 120×.1 s)
caller_partitioning.actual_browser_exposure: The current browser frame loop already accumulates time and calls game.step(.1). This probe addresses direct Game.step callers and future integrations/replays; it does not show frame-rate-dependent variation in that existing fixed-tick browser path.

clipped_oxygen.fixture: White-box active electrolyzer, stocked connected clean-water network, receiving cell oxygen=2.999; one .1 s utility pass.
clipped_oxygen.interpretation: Production counter is nominal output; clamped overflow has no separate loss record. Units are legacy oxygen units, not kg.
clipped_oxygen.expected_under_proposed_v5_contract: Process only receiver headroom, or use an explicitly configured loss/vent policy and record that amount. In all cases nominal production = stored output + explicit loss; no unrecorded 0.029 units.
clipped_oxygen.severity: P0 gate for a conservation-based reconstruction profile; not a claim of normal-play crash or progression failure

tile_displacement.fixture: White-box completion of an actual queued tile; no environmental or crew passes between snapshots.
tile_displacement.interpretation: Existing contents are cleared; no neighboring displacement occurs in _completeTask.

setup.method: queue tile through the public API, then invoke completion directly with no intervening simulation

tile_displacement.expected_under_proposed_v5_contract: Successful completion must transfer contents to legal neighboring receivers with equal aggregate quantities, or wait when no space exists. A loss policy must be explicit and accounted for.
tile_displacement.severity: P0 gate for a conservation-based reconstruction profile; current legacy completion behavior is as coded

partial_coal_fuel.fixture: White-box connected coal generator and empty battery, coal=.001 before one .1 s building pass.
partial_coal_fuel.interpretation: The full 60 W tick is generated when coal > 0, even if the final fuel remainder is below the nominal tick requirement.
partial_coal_fuel.severity: P0 recipe-transaction gate; final partial-fuel edge case, not an assertion of major normal-play balance impact

derived_legacy_balance.notes: Ideal uninterrupted rates only; pathing, outages, growth waits, storage saturation and decay can change observed results. These are current-web calculations, not ONI original values.
